## Verification Checklist

Please run `npm run validate:all` locally before requesting review (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)):

- [ ] `npm run validate:curriculum` passes
- [ ] `npm run validate:links` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with zero errors (`strict: true`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with zero errors or warnings
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Code examples and solutions were reviewed/tested and avoid deprecated APIs (e.g., no `SafeAreaView` or `AsyncStorage` from `react-native`, no `any`)
- [ ] I have read and followed the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
